status_detail: Conceptual control-logic specification for the RFP's air + Xe dual feed. Every guard is symbolic; every threshold value is TBD until the model or test named in its parameter entry supplies it with a source and an evidence class. Not validated. It asserts nothing about whether a mixed-feed or air-only Hall discharge can be ignited, sustained or throttled: gate 3 is FAIL and the credible transport set is empty.

rfp_context.reference: DRDO TDF RFP DTDF/06/13516/DSP/ABEP/X/L/M/01 as summarised in CLAUDE.md and abep_sim/constants.py (the RFP text is not in the repository: verify clause references)
rfp_context.requirement_summary: air + Xe propellants; Hall preferred; thrust, power, mass and life limits as in abep_sim.constants:RFPConstraints
rfp_context.note: The state list is a Vyovrinda control-design proposal; the RFP does not enumerate these states (verify).

architecture_context.scope_rule: Hall transport-ensemble uncertainty belongs to the discharge/thrust block only and never enters upstream guard quantities (intake, compressor, gas chambers, valves). Layer-1 calibration-nuisance variables are never guard quantities or parameters (CLAUDE.md next-work item 1).

guard_semantics.ALL: every condition in every category holds (entries ANDed); entries starting 'n/a:' impose no condition; t_condition counts how long the full condition set has held
guard_semantics.ANY_PERSISTING: fires when any condition in pressure, discharge_current, flows, power, thermal, inventory, sequence or health holds (ORed) and t_condition, the time that trigger set has held continuously, satisfies the timing entries
guard_semantics.priority: fault > protective > command > degradation > recovery > nominal > retry, evaluated every control cycle

expression_grammar.identifiers: declared quantities, parameters or external_refs only

functions.integral: integral(rate, t_in_state): time integral of rate over the dwell in the source state

expression_grammar.numeric_literals: forbidden: every threshold is a named parameter

transition_kinds.retry: bounded self-loop; precondition bounds the counter
transition_kinds.recovery: return after a cleared degradation or restart eligibility
transition_kinds.protective: recoverable anomaly; sequenced shutdown (or OFF from RESTART)

xe_ledger_semantics: xe_consumed.in_source_state is the Xe used from entry into the source state until the transition fires; at_transition is any commanded Xe beyond that. Summing along a path gives the Xe cost of a sequence, which is what m_Xe_reserve_* must cover.

states.description: Unpowered propulsion. All converters off, all propellant valves closed, compressor stopped.
states.rationale: Initial and final state. Exits only on a start/restart command or on a fault latched while off.

states.description: Xe flows through the cathode (and, if the feed design routes it, the anode line) at the purge setpoint with no electrical load except valves; displaces atmospheric species from the cathode region before heating.

valves.xe_anode: open (purge setpoint; TBD — requires feed-system design)

entry_actions: set Xe purge flow to mdot_Xe_purge_set
states.rationale: The repository's cathode model treats atomic O as an emitter poison (abep_sim.plasma_devices:LaB6Cathode.coverage; abep_sim.aochem MATERIAL_CLASS 'LaB6 ... must be Xe-shielded'); purging before heating follows from that model. The need for, and duration of, a purge is TBD — requires cathode O-exposure test.

states.description: Heater on with Xe cathode flow at its setpoint; the emitter is brought to its ignition temperature.
entry_actions: set Xe cathode flow to mdot_Xe_cathode_set
states.rationale: Emitter heating under Xe flow so the emitter is not heated in an O-bearing environment without flow.

states.description: Keeper voltage applied; waits for a coupled keeper discharge. Bounded retries.
states.rationale: Separates keeper coupling from anode ignition so that a keeper failure never reaches the anode supply.

states.description: Magnet on, Xe anode flow at the ignition setpoint, anode voltage V_d_ign applied; waits for a lit, stable Xe discharge. Bounded retries.

outputs.heater: per cathode design (TBD — requires cathode qualification)

entry_actions: set Xe anode flow to mdot_Xe_anode_ign_set
states.rationale: Ignition on Xe only: the Xe path is independent of the atmospheric path, so ignition does not depend on intake/compressor state. Whether a discharge on atmospheric feed could be ignited directly is not assumed.

states.description: Xe-only discharge at the warm-up setpoint for thermal soak. Compressor spin-up is commanded on entry and the atmospheric chamber fills behind the closed atmospheric valve.

outputs.keeper: per cathode design (TBD — requires cathode qualification)

entry_actions: set Xe anode flow to mdot_Xe_anode_warm_set
states.rationale: Overlaps thruster warm-up with the atmospheric chamber fill transient (abep_sim.reservoir:startup_transient) so that admission starts from a filled chamber and a thermally soaked thruster.

states.description: Atmospheric valve opens along a ramp while the Xe anode flow is held; discharge current excursions are monitored.
entry_actions: open atmospheric valve along the admission ramp
states.rationale: Introduces atmospheric species into an established Xe discharge instead of igniting on atmospheric feed. Whether the discharge survives admission is not modelled (no admitted Hall member; no O/O2 chemistry; no Xe + atmosphere mixture) and is a test item.

states.description: Atmospheric valve at its operating opening; Xe anode flow ramps down as the atmospheric fraction rises, closed-loop on I_d.
entry_actions: ramp Xe anode flow down while holding abs(I_d - I_d_ref) within dI_d_band_max
states.rationale: Transfers the discharge from Xe to atmospheric feed gradually so each step can be reversed to Xe fallback.

states.description: Atmospheric feed dominates the anode flow (x_atm_anode >= x_atm_dominant_min); Xe anode flow is at most a trim. Also the Xe-topping state when air-only thrust capability falls short of the command.
entry_actions: limit Xe anode flow to mdot_Xe_anode_trim_max
states.rationale: Mirrors the Xe-topping policy structure of abep_sim.transient:run_mission (air first, Xe anode topping when air thrust is short).

states.description: Anode fed by the atmospheric path only; Xe flows to the cathode only. Intended long-duration mode.
states.rationale: Keeps an Xe-fed cathode because the repository's air-cathode closure did not close the current at life (docs/HISTORY.md v1.1 item 3, model-derived; 'a test, not a design choice'). Xe consumption in this state is the cathode flow only.

states.description: Operation continues at a derated setpoint under a declared non-hard degradation (power shortfall absorbable by throttling, thermal warning, lost sensor redundancy, derated compressor).
entry_actions: throttle to a setpoint with P_prop_demand <= P_avail_prop
states.rationale: Avoids a shutdown/restart cycle (which costs Xe and cathode starts) for degradations that throttling can absorb.

states.description: Atmospheric valve closed; anode on Xe at the fallback setpoint. Used when the atmospheric path is unavailable or the discharge on atmospheric feed is unstable. Bounded by the Xe reserve.
states.compressor: idle or stopped (TBD — requires compressor restart characterization)
entry_actions: set Xe anode flow to mdot_Xe_anode_fallback_set
states.rationale: Keeps the discharge lit on the independent Xe path so that an atmospheric-path anomaly does not force a restart.

states.description: Sequenced shutdown: close atmospheric valve, ramp V_d down, anode off, close Xe anode valve, magnet off, keeper off, heater off, Xe cathode flow kept for the cool-down, then closed; compressor stopped.
entry_actions: hold Xe cathode flow for t_cathode_cooldown_min
states.rationale: The only exits are to OFF (sequence complete) or SAFE_MODE (fault or time-out), so a shutdown never re-enters operation.

states.description: Restart eligibility check after a shutdown: inhibit time, restart counter, Xe reserve, power, cathode start count and exposure history; chooses the cold path (purge) or the warm path (conditioning).
states.xe_rate: none: all Xe valves closed while eligibility is evaluated
states.rationale: Makes restart a checked, counted decision instead of a re-entry into the start sequence.

states.description: All converters off, all propellant valves closed (fail-closed), compressor stopped; fault latched; awaits ground.
states.rationale: Hard-fault sink. Leaves only by ground command to OFF; restart then goes through OFF and RESTART.

flow_tol_rel.description: relative tolerance between commanded and measured flow

mdot_leak_max.description: external leak rate that declares a leak fault

m_Xe_reserve_startup.description: Xe required before a cold start (purge, conditioning, ignition, warm-up and a controlled shutdown)
m_Xe_reserve_startup.value: TBD — requires the per-transition Xe ledger in this file evaluated with qualified flows and dwell times

m_Xe_reserve_restart.description: Xe required before an autonomous restart
m_Xe_reserve_restart.value: TBD — requires the per-transition Xe ledger evaluated with qualified flows and dwell times

m_Xe_reserve_fallback.description: Xe held back so that at least one Xe-fallback episode can complete; required before atmosphere admission from warm-up and for Xe topping
m_Xe_reserve_fallback.value: TBD — requires owner allocation from a mission Xe budget computed with admitted design Hall maps

m_Xe_reserve_shutdown.description: Xe that must remain to execute a controlled shutdown and the allocated restarts
m_Xe_reserve_shutdown.value: TBD — requires the per-transition Xe ledger evaluated with qualified flows and dwell times

p_O_cathode_max.description: largest estimated O partial pressure at the emitter at which heating may start
p_O_cathode_max.value: TBD — requires cathode O-poisoning test (emitter material TBD); the abep_sim coverage model is unvalidated

t_purge_min.value: TBD — requires purge procedure development test

t_purge_validity.description: time after a purge within which a warm restart may skip the purge

t_exposure_max.description: largest cumulative no-flow exposure after which a purge is mandatory

T_emitter_ignite_min.description: emitter temperature required before keeper ignition

T_emitter_cool_max.description: emitter temperature below which Xe cathode flow may stop at shutdown
T_emitter_cool_max.value: TBD — requires cathode qualification test (oxidation at temperature without flow)

P_heater_max.value: TBD — requires cathode heater rating and PPU heater converter design

I_keeper_min.description: keeper current that confirms keeper ignition

I_keeper_max.value: TBD — requires PPU keeper converter design and keeper characterization test

I_keeper_off_max.description: keeper current reading that confirms keeper off
I_keeper_off_max.value: TBD — requires PPU keeper telemetry noise floor

V_keeper_max.description: keeper voltage above which the keeper is not coupled

n_keeper_retry_max.value: TBD — requires FDIR policy (owner) informed by cathode ignition test

n_cathode_starts_max.description: cathode ignition cycles allowed over the mission
n_cathode_starts_max.value: TBD — requires cathode cycle-life test (abep_sim.life:LifeInputs.cathode_start_limit is an unsourced code prior)

V_d_op.value: TBD — requires admitted design Hall maps and thruster test

I_d_detect_min.description: discharge current above which the anode discharge is declared lit
I_d_detect_min.value: TBD — requires PPU current telemetry characterization and ignition test

I_d_off_max.description: discharge current below which the anode discharge is declared off (extinction while V_d is commanded)
I_d_off_max.value: TBD — requires PPU current telemetry noise floor; operational detector, distinct from the pre-registered P5-N2 O1 extinction definition

I_d_overcurrent_max.value: TBD — requires PPU anode converter rating (abep_sim.ppu:Converter.I_max is a sizing input) and thruster test

dI_d_admit_max.value: TBD — requires thruster test on mixed feed (no admitted Hall model)

dI_d_band_max.value: TBD — requires thruster test and PPU regulation design

Id_rms_rel_max.value: TBD — requires thruster test and PPU output-filter design

n_ignite_retry_max.value: TBD — requires FDIR policy (owner) informed by thruster ignition test

T_thruster_warm_min.description: thruster temperature that ends Xe warm-up
T_thruster_warm_min.value: TBD — requires thruster thermal test (abep_sim.thermal is steady-state only)

t_warmup_max.value: TBD — requires thruster thermal/transient test and FDIR policy

T_node_warn.description: per-node warning temperatures (vector over the monitored nodes)
T_node_warn.value: TBD — requires component thermal qualification (abep_sim.thermal:default_nodes T_max_K are unsourced priors)

T_node_trip.description: per-node trip temperatures (vector over the monitored nodes)

compressor_speed_min.description: compressor speed at which the admission pressure is delivered
compressor_speed_min.value: TBD — requires compressor test and abep_sim.compressor evaluation at the design point

compressor_speed_max.value: TBD — requires rotor stress qualification (model estimate abep_sim.compressor:DragCompressor.rpm_limit)

p_atm_chamber_admit_min.description: atmospheric chamber pressure required before admission
p_atm_chamber_admit_min.value: TBD — requires thruster sustainment test on atmospheric feed (no admitted Hall model; no O/O2 chemistry)

p_atm_chamber_min_op.description: atmospheric chamber pressure below which atmospheric operation is abandoned
p_atm_chamber_min_op.value: TBD — requires thruster sustainment test on atmospheric feed

p_atm_chamber_max.value: TBD — requires gas-chamber and valve design pressure

t_atm_fill_max.description: time allowed for the atmospheric chamber to reach the admission pressure
t_atm_fill_max.value: TBD — requires abep_sim.reservoir:startup_transient evaluated for the design plus compressor spin-up test

t_admit_ramp.value: TBD — requires thruster test on mixed feed

t_admit_max.value: TBD — requires thruster test on mixed feed and FDIR policy

t_mixed_dwell_min.value: TBD — requires thruster test on mixed feed

t_mixed_max.value: TBD — requires thruster test on mixed feed and FDIR policy

t_dominant_dwell_min.description: minimum atmosphere-dominant dwell before closing the Xe anode valve
t_dominant_dwell_min.value: TBD — requires thruster test on mixed feed

x_atm_dominant_min.description: atmospheric anode-flow fraction that defines atmosphere-dominant operation
x_atm_dominant_min.value: TBD — requires owner definition of the mode boundary plus thruster test

n_fallback_cycles_max.description: Xe-fallback entries allowed per start before staying in fallback

P_prop_alloc.description: propulsion power allocation (must not exceed the RFP power limit)
P_prop_alloc.value: TBD — requires spacecraft power budget allocation

P_startup_peak.description: peak bus draw of the start sequence
P_startup_peak.value: TBD — requires PPU start-up load evaluation (abep_sim.ppu:load_modes 'startup') with qualified cathode/heater data

P_prop_min_sustain.description: lowest propulsion power at which a discharge can be held

P_prop_idle_max.description: bus draw that confirms all propulsion converters off
P_prop_idle_max.value: TBD — requires PPU quiescent draw specification

t_startup_budget.description: start-command-to-warm-up duration that must fit before eclipse entry
t_startup_budget.value: TBD — requires the sum of qualified dwell times and time-outs

t_stable_confirm.description: time a success condition must hold before a nominal transition fires
t_stable_confirm.value: TBD — requires FDIR design (telemetry rate, noise)

t_fault_confirm.description: persistence filter for fault and protective detection
t_fault_confirm.value: TBD — requires FDIR design (sensor noise, PPU protection response time)

t_restart_inhibit.description: minimum time between shutdown and a new start

t_restart_wait_max.description: time RESTART waits for eligibility before returning to OFF

n_restart_max.description: autonomous restarts allowed before ground intervention

t_shutdown_max.value: TBD — requires cathode qualification test and FDIR policy

t_cathode_cooldown_min.description: minimum Xe-flowing cool-down of the cathode at shutdown

t_clear_min.description: persistence of cleared degradation before recovery

T_margin.description: thrust deficit that triggers Xe anode topping (hysteresis half-width)
T_margin.value: TBD — requires altitude-control law design (abep_sim.transient:run_mission alt_gain is a controller prior)

RFP_power_max.source: DRDO TDF RFP DTDF/06/13516/DSP/ABEP/X/L/M/01, Part III Para 2, as transcribed in abep_sim/constants.py (RFP text not in the repository: verify)

RFP_thrust_max.source: DRDO TDF RFP DTDF/06/13516/DSP/ABEP/X/L/M/01, Part III Para 2, as transcribed in abep_sim/constants.py (verify)
